info.title: Pinpoint API
info.description: Address resolution, spatial matching, and partition management. Port of the Rust pinpoint service — see apps/pinpoint/docs/MIGRATION_PLAN.md.

delete.description: Delete a location. Cascades to its feature, attribute, and layer association rows.

post.description: Set a location's match address and re-run matching. Re-points it to a matched validated master or a fresh PENDING master; the previous auto-created PENDING master is deleted when nothing else links to it.

delete.description: Delete a master location. CASCADE: also deletes every child location linked to it (each cascading its own association rows) and the master location's processing-log rows.

tags.name: BFF
tags.description: UI-shaped endpoints for the Vue SPA (mounted under /bff/...)
